name: Oret
description: In this alternate timeline, a Dromoka cartographer for Commander Faiso and cousin of Anafenza, who executes her on his dragon's command and later keeps her spirit alive.

timeline.summary: The last delegate, her cousin Oret, recognizes Anafenza and is seized with fear.
At her command, an orc forces Oret to his knees, and Anafenza draws the Khan-Blade.
timeline.quote: Anafenza ascended the dais to her throne, and slowly drew her sword, the Khan-Blade, from its scabbard.

timeline.summary: Anafenza is introduced to her cousin Oret and to Gvar Barzeel, a krumar orc raised by her uncle after the battle that killed his Mardu parents and her cousin.
timeline.quote: Gvar was a krumar, which meant he was not born in the Abzan.

timeline.summary: Oret insists the caravan continue to the capital rather than return to Kavah, citing dust storms.
timeline.quote: I must insist we continue to the capital.

timeline.summary: Interrogated, the captured attacker names Oret as the member of her house who hired the Sultai.
Back in the present, Anafenza coolly confronts Oret, who says he thought she was dead.
Anafenza scars Oret's face with the Khan-Blade, disowns him before the First Tree, declares him her enemy, and has Gvar, her brother, show him out.
timeline.quote: I disown you, Oret. You are no longer of my blood.

timeline.summary: At a military camp, soldiers argue about the Guardian, a spirit said to fight for Dromoka troops; Oret says he can tell them who she is.
timeline.quote: I'm the one who killed that spirit in life.

timeline.summary: In the flashback, Oret and Captain Anafenza flee a Kolaghan horde through a canyon after their fortress falls and their lines break.
timeline.quote: But here they were, their fortress lost and their lines broken, fleeing for their lives before the bulk of a Kolaghan horde.

timeline.summary: A Kolaghan orc kills Oret's ibex with a lightning spear and attacks him; Anafenza kills the orc by drawing out his life with golden-white light.
timeline.quote: It passed through him, pulling something unseen but vital from him as it passed, leaving him lifeless in the dust.

timeline.summary: Anafenza leads Oret to a kin-tree in a dead-end chamber, revealing that amber vessels and the carved tree anchor ancestor spirits.
timeline.quote: Spirits can be carried in amber, but I believe the tree is their anchor.

timeline.summary: Oret's scalelord lands in the chamber, crushing the kin-tree and learning of Anafenza's necromancy.
timeline.quote: their scalelord descended into the chamber where, beneath its great weight, the ancient tree fell to splinters.

timeline.summary: Oret asks his scalelord to let him execute Anafenza himself, and the dragon agrees.
timeline.quote: Please, my scalelord, allow me to be the one to execute her.

timeline.summary: Oret beheads Anafenza as she kneels, whispering that it is not the end.
timeline.quote: This is not the end," he whispered to his captain.

timeline.summary: Oret is honored in Kavah, then secretly gathers the amber shards and plants a new tree with Anafenza's name carved in it, erasing it from maps so her spirit has an anchor.
timeline.quote: It was to be Anafenza's tree.

timeline.summary: Oret reveals he now travels the Dromoka lands to tell the truth of the Guardian.
timeline.quote: I now travel our territory to share the truth. She is, as Yeffa said, a guardian.

relations.note: Oret is her cousin, whom she disowns.
relations.quote: Her cousin, Oret, was the house's cartographer

pages_say.description: Anafenza's cousin and house cartographer, who secretly hired the Sultai to destroy their house and is disowned by her as khan.
In this alternate timeline, a Dromoka cartographer for Commander Faiso and cousin of Anafenza, who executes her on his dragon's command and later keeps her spirit alive.
